problem: The three region loaders start together (ops/crontab, 0 1 * * *) and each runs DELETE FROM staging_edge with no region filter, wiping the other regions' staged rows. A loader whose rows were wiped validates zero rows, then deletes its region from edge and inserts nothing. Replayed on an in-memory copy of sql/schema.sql: all three validations passed and only one region kept its edges.
fix: Change the clear in loader/load_region.py to DELETE FROM staging_edge WHERE region = ? and remove the SQL-DEL-001 lint suppression. Before the swap, fail unless the staged row count for the region equals len(rows). Run DELETE FROM staging_edge once to clear leftovers and restore any region already emptied from its last good export.
